lyapunov-stability-master/pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=64", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "lyapunov-stability"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Lyapunov stability analysis for agent systems — convergence, divergence, basin estimation"
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
authors = [{name = "Oracle1", email = "oracle1@cocapn.ai"}]
keywords = ["lyapunov", "stability", "convergence", "dynamical-systems", "cocapn"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Mathematics",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/lyapunov-stability"
